title: Deliminate selective-LHS SEMI delim joins with simple RHS + join filters for RIGHT_SEMI/RIGHT_ANTI
reasons: no visible template faster beyond its noise (best: q04 -9.8%; needs at least -20.7%)
notes: The biggest remaining gain on q04 is getting the Bloom filter through the compressed-materialization projection. Compressed materialization turns the join key into a UINTEGER with an offset, so the Bloom filter is skipped (`has_cast` / `storage_offset` check in physical_hash_join.cpp FinalizeFilters). The memory note on the exact Bloom filter through the offset describes a port: BFTableFilter key offset plus exact-bitmap mode built from the raw compressed min/max. It needs a header change and is a separate idea. It should cut the lineitem probe from 37.9M to about 2.3M rows. Also, without step (2) the deliminated plan had no join filters at all, because delim join conditions are `IS NOT DISTINCT FROM`.
